response.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / sp.proccpu) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram), AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) FROM site_stats GROUP BY entrystat

alternatives.interpretation: If 'ignoring missing values' means to exclude records where procgpu or proccpu is NULL (rather than letting AVG() ignore them), then filter these at the WHERE clause. This would restrict the average RAM calculation as well, only including records with valid procgpu/proccpu.
alternatives.sql: WITH site_stats AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS FLOAT) / sp.proccpu) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 AND sp.procgpu IS NOT NULL AND sp.proccpu IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram), AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) FROM site_stats GROUP BY entrystat
